what_is_being_investigated.central_question: Does CNT, viewed as compositional analysis with time, fit naturally into quaternion algebra such that the four CNT channels (theta, omega, kappa, sigma) become components of a single quaternion-valued trajectory rather than four independent scalar streams?
secondary_questions: Is the period-2 attractor in CNT (LIMIT_CYCLE_P2) a literal spinor signature — i.e., is it the sign of a trajectory that lifts to the SU(2) double cover of SO(3) but not to SO(3) directly?
Is CNT's atan2 step (the bearing computation that replaced arccos) literally the quaternion log map?
Is M^2 = I (the Banach contraction certificate) literally quaternion conjugation, and therefore equivalent to time-reversal symmetry?
Does the 8-class IR taxonomy correspond to the 8 elements of the quaternion group Q_8 (plus or minus 1, i, j, k)?
Is the CBS cube the Cayley diagram of Q_8?
For D=4 carriers specifically, is the Aitchison rotation group SO(D-1)=SO(3) literally the same group whose universal cover is unit quaternions?

_strength_legend.EQUIVALENCE: Algebraic equivalence under explicit transform. Provable.
_strength_legend.ANALOGY: Strong structural similarity but not yet shown to be exact.
_strength_legend.CONJECTURE: Suspected but needs corpus evidence to validate or falsify.

corpus_comparison_method._principle: Every existing CNT run is the reference. QD does not 'analyze' new data — it RE-ANALYZES corpus runs as a quaternion view, then asks: (1) does the quaternion view reproduce the canonical content_sha256 (must), (2) does it expose at least one new structural fact CNT alone cannot, (3) does it stay deterministic and hash-chained.
corpus_comparison_method.primary_test_dataset: backblaze_fleet — D=4 carriers, T=731. Critical because D=4 is the unique simplex dimension where Aitchison's SO(D-1)=SO(3) is exactly the group quaternions cover. If QD doesn't fit cleanly here, the whole exercise is over.
secondary_test_datasets: ember_jpn (D=8, T=26) — twice the quaternion dimension, tests bi-quaternion factoring
geochem_tappe_kim1 (D=10, T=8) — high-D, short-T; tests dimension-reduction adequacy
commodities_gold_silver (D=2, T=1338) — degenerate case, IR=D2_DEGENERATE; tests the boundary of when quaternions are even applicable
esa_planck_cosmic (D=5, T=17) — D=5 is the smallest D > 4; first dataset where quaternions stop being a clean fit

central_claim.tagline: CNT measures invariance. CNQ names the algebra that invariance lives in.
central_claim.origin: Identified by Peter on 2026-05-07, in the Round 2.5 conversation. The general logic: 'proving invariance is proving a tensor; proving dynamics invariant under SO(3) + handedness + time reversal is proving a quaternion.' This crystallises what QD has been demonstrating from Round 2 forward.

general_principle.SO3_matrix: Quantity invariant under 3D rotation, no handedness.
general_principle.quaternion: Quantity invariant under 3D rotation + handedness + time reversal.
general_principle.biquaternion: Quantity invariant under Lorentz boosts + above.
general_principle.clifford_cl_n: Quantity invariant under arbitrary-D rotations + handedness + time reversal.
